paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, as described in the paper "Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models." The chart is divided into 13 distinct segments, each representing a different dataset and labeled with its corresponding percentage contribution. The largest segment, colored blue, is labeled "NQ" and accounts for 31.3% of the data. The second largest, in teal, is "VITAMINC" at 13.0%, followed by "SNLI" in orange at 15.4%. "MULTIFC" (light teal) and "MULTINLI" (red) contribute 11.3% and 11.3% respectively. "FEVER" (dark orange) represents 16.1%, while "SCIFACT" (yellow) is the smallest at 0.1%. Other datasets include "ENTFA" (green) at 1.8%, "FACTCC" (dark green) at 2.6%, "ANLI" (brown) at 4.6%, "XSUMHUL" (light blue) at 1.6%, "SCITAIL" (light green) at 1.2%, and "PUBHEALTH" (purple) at 0.5%. Each segment is connected to its label via a line, and the percentages are displayed directly on the chart, with no legend provided. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with no apparent visual emphasis on any particular slice.
